The '''Durkteel Loop''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route loop between [[Yitabo/Legends|Yitabo]] and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The loop traveled through [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] and [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]]. It was named for [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]] which was along its route. Other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] accessible by the loop included [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]] and [[Kwookrrr]].<ref name="TEA" />
